about: Why the library keeps the clips the sensors flag (PLAN.md WP-5.8; tools/qa/verdict.ts). The writers (npm run import, npm run migrate) record each clip's verdict in its quality: pass, or baselined with a reason that names the level and the metrics past it, then a reason given here for that clip and metric, else its set's, else the warn level's, else how the clip stands to its source (as captured or as keyed, its fit, what its repair did), and last the metrics its tags' profile turns off. npm run qa -- library --check reads every clip's again and names a reason here whose finding is gone. Its shape: tools/qa/qa.schema.json.
warn: short of every fail level the sensors apply (thresholds.ts)

MESH2MOTION/Ledge_Hang.penetration: it hangs by the hands, legs dangling and toes pointed, with its hips at standing height: the toes reach below the floor, which a ledge replaces where it plays

MESH2MOTION/Zombie_Rise.penetration: it rises out of the ground: the hips start 40% of their height under the floor, on purpose

floats.CMU_CURATED/Ballet_Pirouette: it turns in relevé, risen onto the balls of its feet: the hips rise 20–30 mm over their standing height with the heels
floats.CMU_CURATED/Shoot_Bow: its source take (CMU 79_86) holds the left heel 60–70 mm up throughout and the hips 40–70 mm over where the subject's other takes stand them (966–984 mm), while the right foot's toes touch down at 3.5 s: a floor under the heels would sink those toes 40 mm, so it keeps the one its toes show (D69)
floats.CMU_CURATED/Stretch_Yawn: it rises onto its toes as it reaches up: the hips rise 40 mm over their standing height with the heels
